sources.quote: "Position bias is when an LLM exhibits a propensity to favor certain positions over others." "Verbosity bias is when an LLM judge favors longer, verbose responses." Self-enhancement: "the effect that LLM judges may favor the answers generated by themselves." Swap method: "only declare a win when an answer is preferred in both orders" and "If the results are inconsistent after swapping, we can call it a tie." "Only GPT-4 outputs consistent results in more than 60% of cases." "GPT-4 defends significantly better than others" against verbosity. "Due to limited data and small differences, our study cannot determine whether the models exhibit a self-enhancement bias."
sources.supports: Position, verbosity and self-enhancement biases exist in LLM judges, vary across judge models, and the both-orders-agree-else-tie rule is a published mitigation. Self-enhancement evidence is explicitly inconclusive.
